questions.why: The use-case outline lacks critical technical implementation, testing, piloting, monitoring, and training details required to complete Section 6.

items.text: Is the AI model or system being procured from an external vendor, or is it being developed in-house?
What plans, if any, have been established for testing, piloting, and continuously monitoring the AI system's performance and reliability?
What training processes or programs will be implemented to ensure operators and users are sufficiently skilled?

gaps.reason: The outline does not specify whether the AI system or model is being procured or developed in-house, making it impossible to assess procurement suitability.
The outline does not contain details regarding the testing, validation, or reliability evaluation of the AI system.
The outline does not state whether a pilot has been conducted or is planned prior to deployment.
The outline does not provide information on performance monitoring, evaluation plans, or drift detection for the AI system.
The outline does not specify any training, education, or skill-assurance processes for the operators of the AI system.
